run_kitti_evaluation: run KITTI localization evaluation on a given split with directional and yaw error recall metrics
run_kitti_sequential_evaluation: run KITTI sequential localization evaluation with chunking and centered map masking
run_kitti_cli: run the KITTI evaluation CLI with --experiment, --split, and --sequential flags
review_run_function: review the run function that merges configs, creates KittiDataModule, and evaluates metrics
review_default_cfg_sequential: review the default_cfg_sequential OmegaConf that sets mask_radius, prior_range_rotation, and chunking max_length
